messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: unable to install protobuf
parts:
Sandy,

protobuf-2.3.0.tar.gz  is not an R package. You can't install it using R CMD .

Typically one does

tar zxvf protobuf-2.3.0.tar.gz 
cd protobuf*
./configure && make -j2 && sudo make install

(assuming you have root permissions and a dual core processor which makes things faster )

Cheers
Sapsi
